context: This is the quiet, final rooftop scene of Alfira’s arc after the main campaign events have concluded: she’s elated to be atop the Elfsong Tavern and planning to open a bardic school, while noting the tavern’s ghost is the true performer so she won’t sing here. Lakrissa is a close, flirtatious friend (possibly romantic) who works downstairs at the tavern and has been hiding to take a break; off‑screen Alan, a strict authority figure at the Elfsong, is nearby or below and is the reason Lakrissa jokes about keeping quiet. Alfira offers practical help and support, but Lakrissa teases her to focus on music and playfully predicts a life of luxury once the school succeeds. The player can interject with teasing compliments or a mock threat to tell Alan, which the two respond to playfully.
